LEA STONE TO TESS ROWAN. December 11, 1846
Dear colleague,
This record was written on
December 11, 1846. I recorded
an idea about the coastal
dispatch.

Dear colleague,

December 14, 1846. I recorded
an idea about the coastal
dispatch.
